_comment: Models a bundled template references on purpose that nothing can provision yet, usually because a node shipped ahead of its weights. Declared here so validate_manifest.py reports them as a warning instead of a failure, and so it stays obvious what is waiting on whom. Delete an entry the moment the file becomes downloadable and add its group to asset-profiles.json.
